text:
pat: heads-up: toggled tenant `northstar` to v2-prefer for a 2% canary at 09:07 PT. charts showed a short v1 token bump right after. anyone on routing/billing?

console-bot: config-change detected: tenant=northstar v2_prefer=true @2025-02-02T16:07:10Z. dashboards aggregate by billing_meter_key.

anya: quick look: router traces show chosen_route=v2, but billing logs attribute to meter_key:v1 for ~80s. looks like memoized meter-key in billing lagging config change.

ram: we cache tenant->meter mapping for 5m in billing to avoid DB thundering. canary toggles will cause temporary mismatch until cache expiry.

julie: short-term: set pin.ttl=0 for northstar and temporarily lower billing.memo_ttl to 20s for canary-pattern tenants. can someone flip pin.ttl?

opsbot: prod-config-change: pin.ttl(northstar)=0 applied by pat @2025-02-02T16:10:05Z.

ram: i'll deploy a small billing change to add a pubsub invalidation on tenant-routing:update and a short-circuit for keys matching `canary-*`. will open PR and stage it.

anya: UX follow-up: add an ephemeral toast on route toggles: "Note: billing attribution may take up to 2 minutes to reflect route changes" and a chart toggle "show by chosen route / show by billing key" to make the discrepancy explicit.

julie: analytics: expose last_billing_sync_age per tenant and suppress quota alerts for tenants where sync_age>60s and route-change <5m.

pat: thanks. metrics re-aligned ~70s after pin change + early invalidation. filing RFC with owners: ram infra, anya UX, julie analytics. will link PRs and mock in RFC. closing thread once RFC posted. :thumbsup:
